Jio Celebrates 10 Years, Akash Ambani Thanks Employees

Reliance Jio has completed 10 years of operations. Akash Ambani, in a letter to employees, expressed pride in their contributions and reflected on his personal journey with the company. He also outlined Jio's plans for the next decade. The company celebrated its anniversary with employees, acknowledging their role in its success.
